structured_output.summary: The duplicate-ID check in preProcessInstruments indexed slots[i.ID], but slots is 0-based and the store uses slots[i.ID-1]. ID 31 therefore panicked with an index out of range. Duplicate detection was also wrong: ID 1 checked slot 1, so a repeat of ID 1 was missed, and slot 1 could be flagged falsely. The fix indexes with i.ID-1 in the check. I only read the code; nothing was run or edited.
